    y1 = min(H * SCALE, int((cy + padding) * SCALE) + 2)

    gx = (gx + .5) / SCALE - .5
    gy = (gy + .5) / SCALE - .5
    dx, dy = gx - cx, gy - cy
    ca, sa = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
    ex, ey = ca * dx + sa * dy, -sa * dx + ca * dy
    az = np.arctan2(ey / ry, ex / rx)

    perturbation = .025 * np.sin(3 * az + phase) + .013 * np.cos(5 * az - phase)
    distance = (radial - 1 - perturbation) * min(rx, ry)

        vx, vy = cx - nx, cy - ny

        return None
    growth = float(smooth((min(t, detached) - born) / (detached - born)))
    r = radius * (.12 + .88 * growth)
    lip = forward_point((156, 43), min(t, detached))
    offset = np.array([r * .95 + 1.0, -r * .16])
    center = lip + offset
    age = max(0, t - detached)
    center += np.asarray(velocity) * age

    wobble = .055 * math.sin(age * 6.1 + index) * (1 - math.exp(-age * 3)) * math.exp(-age * .45)

    ry = r / (1 + stretch + wobble)

        pinch = 1 - float(smooth((t - (detached - .35)) / .35))

        canvas = cv2.resize(photo, (W * SCALE, H * SCALE), interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)

            (2.58, (156, 44), (16.0, 3.0), 1.25, 1.7),
            (3.72, (156, 43), (11.8, -6.4), 1.75, 2.8),

                age = t - birth
                center = forward_point(p, birth) + np.array([6.5, -2]) + np.asarray(speed) * age
                rr = r * min(1, .3 + age * 3)
                water_lens(canvas, center, rr * (1 + .07 * math.sin(t * 4)), rr, .1,

    assert np.array_equal(frames[0], ORIGINAL)
    artifact_io.save(frames, ROOT)
    return frames

    result = generate()
    print(f"Saved {len(result)} RGB frames: {W}x{H}, {SPEC['fps']} fps")
